about: Search-phrase bank for the weekly scouts. scripts/scouts.py plan picks a few per language for each channel, rotating by ISO week so the same searches are not repeated every Monday. {year} becomes the next intake year, {year_now} the current year. A query is a starting point: results are leads, never facts. Research cycles may add or retire phrases; keep each phrase short and do not put personal data in it.
